title: ChangeConfigurationResponse
description: Response to a change-configuration request with per-key status. If any key is Rejected or NotSupported, the station MUST NOT apply any changes (atomic all-or-nothing).

results.description: Per-key results in the same order as the request keys array

errorCode.description: OSPP error code. SHOULD accompany a Rejected or NotSupported result (08-configuration.md section 8.2) — a SHOULD, which is why no if/then requires it here.

errorText.description: Machine-readable error name. SHOULD accompany a Rejected or NotSupported result (08-configuration.md section 8.2) — a SHOULD, which is why no if/then requires it here.
